targets.self_route_verdict: rejected -- mislabels a test-design defect as substrate immaturity (the V3-EXQ-642 pattern)

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: dual-process control: goal-directed/model-based recruitment under novelty vs habitual/model-free control under familiarity; dorsomedial-to-dorsolateral striatal transfer with training
biological_reference.divergence: None demonstrated. The biology predicts the recruitment contrast scales with genuine novelty -- exactly the quantity the manipulation check says was insufficient -- so the run does not discriminate a working mechanism under a weak contrast from no mechanism.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-07-20 (failure autopsy, V3-EXQ-786): NON-CONTRIBUTORY -- the manipulation check failed, so novel and familiar were never established as distinct conditions and the load-bearing C1 is stamped criteria_non_degenerate false. The manifest self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue; the autopsy rejects that label. FamiliarityTracker is present and discriminating, returning a separation of 0.049365 against a 0.05 floor (short by 1.3%) -- a test-design defect, not substrate immaturity. Two design-time causes, both in the committed config: env_drift_interval 5 / drift_prob 0.1 erodes familiarity throughout the 20 practice episodes, and 'novel' layouts differ from 'familiar' only by generator seed on a 10x10 grid. The design was also underpowered against its own margin -- clearing mean - SEM > 0.05 at the observed SEM of 0.0117 needs a mean of 0.062, ~4.7x the observed 0.0133, with sample_size_improvable true at n=5. Routed to /queue-experiment as V3-EXQ-786a (same question) with a strengthened manipulation and a powered margin. This run must NOT weigh against MECH-163. Separately, per the run's own scope_note this tests leg (1) only -- legs (2) and (3) remain blocked by ARC-007 STRICT and by the unbuilt ARC-071, so even a PASS would not confirm the full dual-system claim.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.rationale: FamiliarityTracker is present and discriminating; there is no substrate gap in this run's causal path. ARC-071 (unbuilt) and ARC-007 (STRICT value-flat) do block MECH-163 legs 2 and 3, but neither caused this FAIL and both are already tracked.

measured_design_constraint.under_config: 10x10 grid, num_hazards 3, num_resources 5, env_drift_interval 5, drift_prob 0.1, practice_episodes_per_layout 20, novel/familiar differ by generator seed only, familiarity_bandwidth 1.0
measured_design_constraint.note: Reusable, BUT BANDWIDTH-CONDITIONAL -- read the caveat before designing against this number.
measured_design_constraint.bandwidth_caveat: ANNOTATED 2026-07-20 (during V3-EXQ-786a authoring; verdict, category, direction, routing and recommended_substrate_queue_entry all UNCHANGED). 0.049365 was measured at familiarity_bandwidth = 1.0, the default. FamiliarityTracker.query (ree-v3/ree_core/hippocampal/curiosity.py:72-100) is a CLAMPED SUM over anchors, and at bw=1.0 it pins at 1.0 in BOTH the familiar and the novel condition -- the readout has no dynamic range there, so 0.049365 is residual noise near a saturated ceiling, NOT an achievable instrument ceiling. Measured on the same substrate, raw familiar-vs-novel separation by query bandwidth: bw 0.05 -> +0.019, 0.10 -> +0.103, 0.20 -> +0.171, 0.30 -> +0.065, 0.50 -> -0.053 (INVERTED), 1.00 -> +0.000. At bw=0.20 with a full training budget the achievable separation is ~0.19, roughly 4x the recorded value; V3-EXQ-786a measures at bw=0.20. A successor must therefore NOT treat 0.049365 as the number to beat, and must not conclude the manipulation is near an instrument ceiling -- it is not. Bandwidth is the parameter that determines this value and was the one parameter omitted from under_config as originally written.

re_derive_brake.note: First autopsy on MECH-163: 0 prior targets, 0 substrate_ceiling hits.

learning_extracted: A manipulation check that fails by ~1% is a design finding, not a substrate finding. The self-route took the expensive branch (/implement-substrate) for what is a re-queue.

Environmental drift applied during a familiarisation phase works against that phase's purpose: env_drift_interval 5 / drift_prob 0.1 decays familiarity across the same 20 episodes meant to build it. Check whether an always-on env process opposes a phase's objective before setting its budget.

Sampling 'novel' layouts from the same generator as 'familiar' ones caps the contrast by construction; on a small grid with fixed object counts a different seed is not a different layout in any sense the familiarity metric registers.

Pre-register the margin against a power calculation, not an intuition. Required mean = margin + SEM is one arithmetic step at design time and would have shown 0.05 was unreachable -- the same class of design-time-provable gate defect the V3-EXQ-785 autopsy found.
Report the achievable value alongside the pass/fail: familiarity_separation 0.049365 is the number a successor design needs, and a bare 'precondition unmet' would have discarded it.

required_changes: Suppress or lengthen env drift during the practice phase so familiarity can accumulate; and/or raise practice_episodes_per_layout above 20
Vary layout-generating parameters (grid size, hazard/resource counts, landmarks) between familiar and held-out layouts rather than the seed alone
Raise n above 5 or re-derive divergence_margin from a measured effect size, recording the power calculation in the queue entry
Keep the manipulation check as a GATING precondition -- it worked as intended, catching an uninterpretable run before it could weigh against a claim

hypothesis_space_ledger_applied.basis: MECH-163 has no question in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json and this run discriminates nothing (manipulation check failed), so there is no leg to pre-register or resolve. Registering one now would add a denominator entry with no adjudicating evidence.
